detail.longDescription: Do coding agents actually need "memory"? Decay curves, forgetting policies, vector recall of what I did last Tuesday. I keep landing on the boring alternative: a solid set of instructions/manifests in the repo + a catalog of proven solutions. Versioned, reviewable, diffable. The repo is the memory. Honest question: has anyone seen decaying agent memory actually beat a well-written CLAUDE.md? # AI # LLM # AIAgents # DevTools # ContextEngineering # SoftwareEngineering
